tasks.label: cleanup-processes
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name python,sam,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Path -like '*evalytics*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*vite*'} | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '✓ Cleaned up old processes' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: start-api
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/API; sam build; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '🚀 API Server starting...' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '📍 URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; sam local start-api --port 3000 --template .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --docker-network host

tasks.label: start-ui
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; cd ${workspaceFolder}/UI; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '🎨 UI Server starting...' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '📍 URL: http://localhost:5173' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '========================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; npm run dev

tasks.label: ⛔ Stop Dev Servers
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name python,sam,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Path -like '*evalytics*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*vite*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*sam*'} | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host '✓ Stopped all dev servers' -ForegroundColor Red
